Class AbstractFileRepository<ID,E>

java.lang.Object
repository.InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
repository.AbstractFileRepository<ID,E>

ID - the identifier type
E - the entity type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Repository<ID,E>
Direct Known Subclasses:
PrietenieFileRepository, UtilizatorFileRepository
public abstract class AbstractFileRepository<ID,E> extends InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
Provides file loading and persistence for validated entities.
